text:
Type: landscape canvas with copper leaf
Use: wall decoration above a sofa, bed or sideboard; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: traditional, coastal, contemporary
Materials: textured canvas print, copper leaf accents
Colors: cloudy white, slate blue, grey, warm copper
Shape: large square, frameless, cloudy sky over marsh water with metallic reed bands, painterly texture
Feel: serene, airy, warm
Goes with: grey or blue walls, warm wood, copper or bronze accents; traditional, coastal or transitional rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Traditional Landscape Print with Copper Leaf Wall Art Decor on Canvas - 35" x 35"
product.description: Bring a sense of classic elegance into your home with this enchanting piece of landscape wall art. Reminiscent of traditional landscape art, this print utilizes a serene color palette that will complement most home-décor styles. This piece is printed on canvas and features hand-painted details. 35"H x 35"W x 1.5"D Printed canvas with hand-painted details This abstract landscape features white clouds with shades of blue and gold accents.
